items.title: $58 billion In Payouts, A Lagging Stock: The T Trade-Off

items.title: 3 of Wall Street’s Favorite Stocks We Approach with Caution
items.summary: The stocks in this article have caught Wall Street’s attention in a big way, with price targets implying returns above 20%. But investors should take these forecasts with a grain of salt because analysts typically say nice things about companies so their firms can win business in other product lines like M&A advisory.

items.title: Charter Communications (CHTR) Files Shelf Registration And Launches Major Debt Exchange Offer
items.summary: Charter Communications filed a new shelf registration for potential future debt offerings. The company launched a fixed-income exchange offer for secured senior notes due in 2038 and 2041. These moves relate to Charter Communications' capital structure and debt profile and matter for bondholders and equity investors in NasdaqGS:CHTR.
